definitions.explanation: Fixing or restoring something that is damaged or deteriorated, especially buildings, roads, and infrastructure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補修|ほしゅう}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補修|ほしゅう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。

⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{校舎|こうしゃ}→校舎：02801_kousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補修|ほしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{多額|たがく}→多額：12309_tagaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Repairing the aging school building will cost a large amount.

notes:
USAGE:
{補修|ほしゅう} refers to repairing things that have deteriorated over time, particularly structures and infrastructure. It implies restoring something to a functional state rather than replacing it entirely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {補修|ほしゅう}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (repair work/construction)
- {補修|ほしゅう}{費用|ひよう} (repair costs)
- ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補修|ほしゅう} (road repair)
- {補修|ほしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to repair)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧ is a broader term for fixing broken items (appliances, machines). {補修|ほしゅう} focuses on maintaining or patching up structures and facilities. ⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧ is more formal and often used for building maintenance.
